create.name: Sacha Heath
create.bio:
Sacha Heath is a yoga teacher, singer and writer whose teaching centres on deep rest. She has practised yoga and chanted mantra for close to three decades, and in the last ten years her own practice has turned more and more towards Tibetan Buddhism and the mystical traditions of the feminine. For eight years she lived on Corfu, where she co-founded and ran Mandala Yoga B&B, a small retreat house, before moving back to a farm in Britain.

Her classes lean towards the slow end of yoga: yin, restorative floor work she calls Lazy Yoga, and yoga nidra, often closed with live mantra and harmonium. She also leads kirtan, has recorded devotional albums, and trained as a voice teacher after losing and then rebuilding her own singing voice. Today she offers one-to-one voice and creative mentoring sessions, circles and private sessions for mothers under the name The Yoga of Motherhood, occasional day retreats in the UK and a week-long creative retreat on Corfu with the musician Tex. Her monthly live practice and her recorded meditations are on Insight Timer, and her YouTube channel, Yoga with Sacha, holds full classes and chants.

You can choose singing and vocal work, mentoring for a creative project, or private Yoga of Motherhood sessions for mothers taking stock of how their lives have changed; mantra can be brought in where it fits.

courses.title: The Artful Life: Creative Retreat in Corfu
courses.description: A seven-night retreat in June 2027 on Corfu, co-hosted with the musician Tex Drieschner, mixing creative practice, music, conversation and rest. Fuller details and booking are still to be published.

courses.title: Mothers' Circles
courses.description: Small circles, online and in person, where mothers rest, talk and listen to one another without advice or judgement. They are part of her Yoga of Motherhood work; dates are shared with her mailing list.

free_resources.title: Sacha Heath on Insight Timer

free_resources.title: Rested & Reconnected Kit
free_resources.description: A free kit built around the five elements of earth, water, fire, air and space. Each element comes with a short recorded practice, such as yoga nidra, gentle movement or a sung mantra, plus a few journal questions.
